programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Guy Mounier, the CEO of Aptivio, seeks a $500,000 investment to expand his AI-driven lead generation business. Aptivio's AI engine, similar to ChatGPT, analyzes online behavior to identify potential clients. However, the investors express concerns about market saturation and the clarity of Aptivio's value proposition.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Matthew Aarsvold, the owner and president of IKW Solutions, takes center stage, seeking $1,000,000 to elevate his innovative software, Constantly Current. This cutting-edge prototype promises to transform Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems by ensuring they remain updated seamlessly, offering potential time and cost savings for businesses.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day 4 of Teaching the Teachers focuses on learning to hear the “small still voice for God” through prayer and meditation. It also explores spiritual guidance as an art—meeting others where they are, honoring intuitive limits, and teaching without reinforcing ego or victimhood.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day 5 of Teaching the Teachers reveals that spiritual health and mental health are one. Suffering comes from thinking apart from love, while healing comes through forgiveness and atonement. The role of therapist or teacher is to help remove the barriers to love’s presence.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day 6 of Teaching the Teachers reminds us that our worth comes from God, not success or recognition. True stature comes from grounding in what’s real, not clicks or followers. Teaching and service require integrity, generosity, and deep preparation—giving fully whether paid or not.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 5 introduces the practice of lovingkindness, or metta—a meditation rooted in connection and care. Using gentle phrases, we affirm our shared humanity and inner potential for growth and love. This practice invites curiosity rather than force, allowing experience to unfold naturally.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day 4 of Teaching the Teachers focuses on learning to hear the “small still voice for God” through prayer and meditation. It also explores spiritual guidance as an art—meeting others where they are, honoring intuitive limits, and teaching without reinforcing ego or victimhood.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day 5 of Teaching the Teachers reveals that spiritual health and mental health are one. Suffering comes from thinking apart from love, while healing comes through forgiveness and atonement. The role of therapist or teacher is to help remove the barriers to love’s presence.

programme.title: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programme.desc: Day 6 of Teaching the Teachers reminds us that our worth comes from God, not success or recognition. True stature comes from grounding in what’s real, not clicks or followers. Teaching and service require integrity, generosity, and deep preparation—giving fully whether paid or not.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg

programme.title: The Rico No Suave Talk Show

programme.desc: R&B Singer Kerry James influenced by his Icons..So he dedicated a song to his Mom! We had a blast with Kerry and all of the things that he has accomplished and other obstacles! Support this gentleman!

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: A diagnosis of childhood cancer came as a shock to the Shoeneck family who found out about their daughter Kenedi's malignant tumor after an unexpected fall. This episode of Hope is Here proves the power of love and creativity as The Sing Me a Story Foundation pairs Kenedi and well-known songwriter Kat Perkins to create a happy and memorable tune that delivers hope, strength, and laughter to a family who needs a reason to smile.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: Our youth and all the experiences that makeup one's childhood, good and bad, can affect the person we ultimately become. Yet we often have a choice in that destiny. Ana Viamonte Ros is a woman who confirms that although insurmountable challenges and negative experiences from the past can shape our future, hard work and a determined, healthy mindset can pave the way toward a gratifying life. Today Dr. Viamonte dedicates her life to helping patients strengthen their mental health and conquer childhood traumas while serving as living proof that perseverance and hope make dreams attainable.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.desc: The way to healing can take on different forms. Little 7-year-old Leonor, was suffering from a very rare cancer, and it was decided she needed an uplifting project to give her hope. What better medicine than an endearing song that was created from Lenore and her sister Dot's imagination and a ridiculously cute and famous dog named Doug the Pug? This episode of Hope is Here is about how a famous dog, creativity, and a group of caring individuals came together to give a little girl a world of hope to carry on. The path to healing can manifest in various ways. Meet Leonor, a resilient 7-year-old girl battling a highly uncommon form of cancer. Recognizing her need for inspiration and optimism, a heartwarming project was conceived. What could be more uplifting than a captivating melody born from the vivid imaginations of Leonor and her sister Dot, accompanied by the adorable and renowned Doug the Pug? In this episode of Hope is Here we witness the extraordinary convergence of a beloved canine, boundless creativity, and a compassionate community, all united to bestow upon a young girl a profound sense of hope for the future.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.desc: Founder, Glenn Marsden, of Imperfectly Perfect Campaign, and Jeremy Jackson, former Baywatch star share their personal journeys with body dysmorphia and how it led to a worldwide campaign. A young man faces his fears and a tale of kindness at 30,000 ft.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.sub-title: Good Morning Joy - Steps to Brave Healing
programme.desc: Laura Di Franco, CEO of Brave Healer Productions, discusses brave healing and the power of sharing our stories. And, meet Oyen the ginger cat and adorable kids from India, along with Daaji redefining meditation for a joyful heart.

programme.title: Good Morning Joy
programme.sub-title: Good Morning Joy - Eat Happily Ever After
programme.desc: Join The Kitchen Psychic, Hannah McKitrick, as we talk ditching diets, embracing food freedom, and finding lightness in mind and body, alongside Susan Noles from The Golden Bachelor for some fun, and meditation leader Daaji discussing compassion.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - Human Nature vs. Modern Culture
programme.desc: As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - Approaching Trauma with Curiosity and Compassion
programme.desc: Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.

programme.title: A Return To Wholeness
programme.sub-title: A Return To Wholeness - The Connection Between Health and Childhood Trauma
programme.desc: There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

programme.title: Life Stories with Marc Hoberman
programme.sub-title: LSWMH - Rod Argent & Colin Blunstone of The Zombies
programme.desc: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inductees, Rod Argent and Colin Blunstone of The Zombies, are today's guests on Life Stories with Marc Hoberman. Rod and Colin talk about their 50 plus years in Rock and Roll as well as their new album. The Legends who are famous for Time of the Season, She's Not There, and many more also offer sage advice for young, aspiring musicians.

programme.title: Life Stories with Marc Hoberman
programme.desc: American Ninja Warrior Champion Daniel Gil talks about training, competition, homeschooling, and more.

programme.title: Life Stories with Marc Hoberman
programme.desc: Radio icon and Radio Hall of Fame Inductee Shadoe Stevens is our guest on Life Stories with Marc Hoberman. Stevens talks about the obstacles he had to overcome in order to succeed in radio. He also talks about his children's book and the passion and drive needed to be successful. He credits FAILURE as the driving force of his success!

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: Una Navidad Para Recordar
programme.desc: Sebastián detesta la navidad. Y esta le será particularmente difícil, puesto que es la primera que pasa sin sus hijos, después de un duro divorcio. Decide alejarse de la ciudad y pasar la temporada en la casa en que nació, visitando a su madre Ángela, que padece alzheimer. En esa breve y nostálgica temporada, SEBASTIÁN reencuentra la fe en la vida, se reconcilia con la familia, consigue un nuevo camino para el amor y recupera la emoción de la Navidad.

programme.title: Una Navidad Complicada
programme.desc: En medio de la temporada navideña, Leticia y Guillermo, divorciados desde hace años, enfrentan una situación inesperada cuando su hijo adolescente recurre a una trampa para reunirlos, falsificando un correo electrónico conde invita a Guillermo y su nueva novia a la casa familiar para Navidad. A medida que la forzada convivencia avanza, la relación entre Guillermo y su exesposa va cambiando. Guillermo descubre cuanto extraña su antigua vida, su vida familiar estable y hermosa. Y descubre que sigue amando a Leticia. Pero, para regresar definitivamente, necesita ganarse el perdón de Leticia y demostrarle que está dispuesto a cambiar. No es tan fácil, pero tal vez el espíritu navideño ayude a que suceda el milagro.

programme.title: Intercambio Navideno
programme.desc: MAYA y ANA MARÍA son gemelas. Pero fueron separadas al nacer y entregadas a diferentes familias. Fueron criadas de maneras opuestas. ANA MARÍA es ahora una exitosa empresaria divorciada, que solo piensa en su éxito y en el trabajo. MAYA una incansable filántropa, criada por una familia que se dedica a trabajar en pro de los más necesitados. Ya adultas se descubren una a la otra y deciden guardar el secreto, para no hacer daño a sus familias. Pero una navidad deciden hacer la travesura de intercambiar sus vidas por una noche. Sin sospechar que aquella decisión las cambiará para siempre.

Pero el viudo JUAN ANDRÉS y su hija LAURITA han tenido la misma idea. Por un error les alquilan la misma casa. La zona está llena por la temporada y se ven obligados a compartir el lugar, en principio por una noche. Pero una serie de circunstancias hacen que la situación se alargue. La magia navideña hace de las suyas y, poco a poco, entre ISABEL y JUAN ANDRÉS surge una atracción muy especial.

programme.title: Losing Is Worse Than Death | The Bill Tierney Documentary
programme.desc: Coach Bill Tierney is a legend. Over his five decade coaching career, he's accomplished almost everything: NCAA Championships, Coach of the Year honors, induction into the Hall of Fame. The last accomplishment left for his resume? A PLL Championship. Philadelphia finished 2-8 in Coach Tierney's inaugural year at the helm. Now in his second season, Tierney is aiming to right the ship and has his sights on one more ring.

programme.title: La grande galerie de la Francophonie
programme.sub-title: Antoine de Caunes / Marguerite Li-Garrigue / Kent Monkman
programme.desc: He is a legend of French television, an iconic presenter, director and man of culture. Antoine de Caunes has influenced generations with his unique sense of irreverence. He comes to tell us about his relationship with art and to talk about "Antoine de Caunes, la vie rêvée d'un enfant du rock", the Canal+ documentary series. Also with us is Marguerite Li-Garrigue, one of the most promising artists on the contemporary scene: a unique universe, a rare intensity and a passion for insects, at the heart of delicate and powerful works. Canadian painter Kent Monkman as seen by Alex Vizorek, in the Vizorek'xpert column.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S10

programme.desc: The first big muster is over, but someone didn’t make it back home. Milton sends out a search party to track down one of his most trusted workers. Raine takes Jeff on a shopping trip and on the way back…. she picks up a live crocodile.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 5
programme.desc: Milton has put a bounty on the biggest barramundi someone can catch at Coolibah. It’s an annual fishing competition.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 6
programme.desc: It’s race day: the showdown between Trevor the Cranky Cook and Milton’s sister Terry. The last time Trevor raced was in 1984, when his horse threw him in the final straight. Milton finds a massive python…that has swallowed a wallaby.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 7
programme.desc: Bushfires break out at Coolibah. It’s Milton’s worst fear. With the fire burning up paddocks of cattle feed, he’ll have to fight through the night to contain it.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 8
programme.desc: The Joneses leave the comfort of Coolibah to spend a few days at the 100th Anniversary Brunette Races & Camp Draft. Cristina’s been training on her prized horse for months. But how will she fare against the toughest cowboys in Australia?

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 9
programme.desc: Milton faces his worst nightmare. News is radioed through that a chopper has crashed 50km from Coolibah. He heads up a search party to find the wreckage and, hopefully, survivors.

programme.title: Keeping up with the Joneses
programme.sub-title: Keeping Up With The Joneses Episode 10
programme.desc: Milton encounters a fiery act of nature. Raine gives Little Milton a lesson about the Indigenous people of the Territory. And Milton carries out the dying wish of his mate Buckley. It’s a wake, Northern Territory style.
